[[Ryan William Downey]] ([[XY066]]-present)| }} '''Clemont's Heliolisk''' (Japanese: '''シトロンのエレザード''' ''Citron's Elezard'') was one of the three original {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} acquired by {{an|Clemont}} in the [[Kalos]] [[region]] prior to the start of ''[[Pokémon the Series: XY]]''. Heliolisk also appeared in the {{pkmn|games}} and {{pkmn|manga}} Clemont appears in. ==In animation== ===''Pokémon the Series''=== ===={{aniseries|XY}}==== [[File:XY009 Clemont VS Clembot.png|thumb|left|250px|Heliolisk and Clembot facing Bunnelby and Clemont]] As revealed in ''[[XY031|The Cave of Trials!]]'', Clemont got Heliolisk as a Helioptile and then evolved it using a [[Sun Stone]] prior to the start of ''[[Pokémon the Series: XY]]''. Sometime after evolving, Clemont lent it to [[Clembot]] before he left the [[Lumiose Gym]] with {{an|Bonnie}}. Heliolisk debuted in ''[[XY009|Clemont's Got a Secret!]]''. When Clemont had a {{pkmn|battle}} with Clembot to determine official ownership of the [[Gym]], Clembot sent out Heliolisk against [[Clemont's Bunnelby]]. During Clemont's time away from the Gym, Heliolisk was taught how to counter opponents using {{m|Dig}}, which was seen when Heliolisk used {{m|Bulldoze}} on Bunnelby. Bunnelby turned the tables by confusing Clembot and Heliolisk was subdued by Bunnelby's combo of Dig and {{m|Mud Shot}}. After the battle, Clemont ran to it to see if it was okay in which Heliolisk responded that it was. Heliolisk then cheered along with the group after Clemont was able to reprogram Clembot. In ''[[XY065|Good Friends, Great Training!]]'', Clembot sent Heliolisk out to battle [[Tierno's Squirtle]] in Tierno's flashback of the battle and lost, earning Tierno the Voltage Badge. [[File:Clembot and Heliolisk.png|thumb|250px|Heliolisk and Clembot]] In ''[[XY066|Confronting the Darkness!]]'', Clembot sent it out to battle [[Belmondo]]'s {{p|Magneton}} under the [[Dark Clembot]]'s control. The battle went on until {{TRT}} captured both Clembots using their mecha. After Team Rocket was defeated by [[Meyer|Blaziken Mask]], Clemont got Heliolisk's {{i|Poké Ball}} and recalled it after Clembot couldn't continue. [[File:Ash Goodra vs Clemont Heliolisk.png|thumb|250px|left|Heliolisk battling Goodra]] In ''[[XY067|The Moment of Lumiose Truth!]]'', Heliolisk was used in a Gym battle and his second choice against {{Ash}}. It first went up against [[Ash's Goodra]]. Heliolisk was quicker than Goodra as none of Goodra's attacks were able to hit it. Ash recalled Goodra after Heliolisk {{status|paralyzed}} it with {{m|Thunder Wave}}. Heliolisk's next opponent was [[Ash's Hawlucha]], who was picked to match Heliolisk's speed. When Heliolisk began to use {{m|Flash}} and opened its collar, Ash had Hawlucha use {{m|High Jump Kick}} on the exposed collar, knocking Heliolisk out. After Ash's victory, it was left back with Clembot at the gym along with {{TP|Clemont|Magnemite}} and {{TP|Clemont|Magneton}}. In ''[[XY132|A Towering Takeover!]]'', Heliolisk appeared alongside Clembot, who had come to Clemont, {{an|Serena}}, and Bonnie's aid to help them get through the giant root-infested [[Lumiose City]]. It battled against [[Bryony]]'s {{p|Liepard}} and [[Aliana]]'s {{p|Druddigon}} in ''[[XY133|Coming Apart at the Dreams!]]''. Alongside the rest of Clemont's Pokémon, it defeated the Team Flare Scientists' Pokémon, allowing Clembot to subdue them and for the team to infiltrate the [[Lumiose Gym]]. In ''[[XY137|Battling With a Clean Slate!]]'', Heliolisk was the last Pokémon used by Clembot in a Gym battle against a Trainer named [[Alvin]]. It was able to dodge Alvin's Cubone's {{m|Brick Break}} easily and dealt some damage with {{m|Dragon Tail}} and {{m|Focus Blast}}. It eventually fell to Cubone's supereffective {{m|Bonemerang}}. ====Personality and characteristics==== [[File:Clemont Heliolisk collar.png|thumb|left|250px|Heliolisk extending its collar]] [[File:Clemont and Heliolisk.png|thumb|250px|Heliolisk and Clemont]] Little is known about Heliolisk's personality due to how little screentime it has gotten from staying at the [[Lumiose Gym]]. It is Clemont and [[Clembot]]'s main battling Pokémon, preferring it over {{TP|Clemont|Magnemite}} and {{TP|Clemont|Magneton}}. It is a skilled and speedy battler, easily running circles around its opponents and using Parabolic Charge to recover its health. In ''[[XY067|The Moment of Lumiose Truth!]]'', it was revealed its collar is a weak point for Heliolisk, who extends it when attacking. Heliolisk is a very happy and energetic Pokémon, dancing on the battlefield when it saw Clemont was there. It takes Clemont's orders seriously, giving its all in battle against its Trainer and {{TP|Clemont|Bunnelby}}. Heliolisk works well with both its Trainer and his invention [[Clembot]]. {{-}} ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|electric|normal|Clemont Heliolisk {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 4}}|0=Dragon Tail|1=Bulldoze|2=Flash|3=Focus Blast}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 4}}|0=Dragon Tail|1=Bulldoze|2=Flash|3=Focus Blast}}|image2=Clemont Heliolisk {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 4}}|0=Parabolic Charge|1=Parabolic Charge 2|2=Thunderbolt|3=Thunder Wave}}.png|caption2=Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 4}}|0=Parabolic Charge|1=Parabolic Charge|2=Thunderbolt|3=Thunder Wave}}}} {{anmov|electric|Thunderbolt|XY009|Clemont's Got a Secret!}} {{anmov|Dragon|Dragon Tail|XY009|Clemont's Got a Secret!|rec=yes}} {{anmov|ground|Bulldoze|XY009|Clemont's Got a Secret!}} {{anmov|electric|Parabolic Charge|XY009|Clemont's Got a Secret!}} {{anmov|normal|Flash|XY067|The Moment of Lumiose Truth!|rec=yes}} {{anmov|electric|Thunder Wave|XY067|The Moment of Lumiose Truth!}} {{anmov|fighting|Focus Blast|XY137|Battling with a Clean Slate!|rec=yes}} {{anmov/f|normal}} ===GOTCHA!=== Clemont's Heliolisk briefly appeared in [[GOTCHA!]]. ==In the games== ===In the core series=== [[Clemont]]'s Heliolisk appears in the following games. ===={{g|X and Y}}==== {{Pokémon/Grid}} {{Pokémon |caption='''Gym battle''' |gen=6 |ndex=0695 |pokemon=Heliolisk |level=37 |gender=male |type1=Electric|type2=Normal |ability=Dry Skin |move1=Thunderbolt|move1type=Electric|move1cat=Special |move2=Quick Attack|move2type=Normal|move2cat=Physical |move3=Grass Knot|move3type=Grass|move3cat=Special }} {{Pokémon |caption='''[[Battle Chateau]]

It was captured by [[Xerosic]] to be used as a hostage to force Clemont to build a machine for [[Team Flare]]. In ''[[PS593|Xerneas Gives]]'', Clemont retrieved Heliolisk and used it to combat Team Flare at {{rt|10|Kalos}} in order to free the Pokémon that Team Flare had captured. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|electric|normal|Bonnie Dedenne Alexa Heli Electric Terrain Adventures.png|Using Electric Terrain}} {{anmov|Electric|Electric Terrain|PS593|Xerneas Gives}} {{anmov/f|normal}} ==Trivia== * Heliolisk is the only signature Pokémon of one of Ash's Gym Leader companions to not be on hand at the beginning of their {{pkmn|journey}}. * Heliolisk has used the most [[move]]s out of all of Clemont's Pokémon, with a total of seven. * Heliolisk is the only one of Clemont's Pokémon to have a unique [[List of Pokémon with unique type combinations|type combination]]. ==Related articles== {{Animespeciesevo1|Helioptile|Heliolisk}} {{Clemont's Pokémon|electric|normal}} {{Project Anime notice|no}} [[Category:Clemont's Pokémon|Heliolisk]] [[Category:X and Y characters]] [[Category:Pokémon Adventures characters (Pokémon)]] [[es:Heliolisk de Clemont/Lem]] [[fr:Iguolta de Lem]] [[it:Heliolisk di Lem]] [[ja:シトロンのエレザード]] [[zh:希特隆的光电伞蜥]]
